text: Picture a co-op paying sixty-four cacao farmers from handwritten weigh-slips.
A duplicate, or a fine no rule allows, goes unseen.
Members can't check their pay; the buyer can't prove its premium arrived.
Fair Split: Claude reads the paper.
Code computes every amount and holds what it can't justify.
Two officers sign large batches. A simulated PayPal pays;
cash members get the same statement. The buyer re-checks it all.
Slips go to Claude, then a deterministic engine. Two keys sign one batch hash.
An outbox makes each simulated PayPal call safe to retry.
What's special: a split matrix that rebalances;
a frozen rate card; two keys, one hash;
proof in your browser; pay you can hear; and Try to break it.
Each delivery gets a handwritten slip and a pink carbon copy.
Photograph both, and it counts twice.
Lantern Bay, the chocolate buyer,
pays one invoice through PayPal's Agent Toolkit, on a simulated sandbox.
Here is Claude's real reading of one slip.
The run itself replays a labelled stand-in;
treasurer Analyn types a stained digit by hand.
Counted once, the duplicate's money returns to the other sixty-three members,
and the dial drops inside the limit.
Two more holds, each decided by a person. Analyn tries adding a deduction.
Refused: the rate card was locked before the first slip.
Above three hundred dollars, two keys: Analyn holds to sign;
the Chair co-signs the same batch hash on his phone.
The simulated PayPal accepts the batch: sent, not yet paid.
Seven items confirm; a member without PayPal moves to cash.
Lantern Bay opens Proof and re-checks the rate card,
both signatures and every line, in its own browser.
Her pay traces to four slips. She hears it in Cebuano.
Premium gikan sa Lantern Bay Chocolate Co.:
forty-three dollars and sixty-nine cents, walay kaltas.
Underneath: over five thousand automated tests and three kill switches.
Others we found share parts; none starts from a handwritten weigh-slip.
The limits: PayPal runs on a simulated sandbox.
People and data are synthetic; no real farmer was paid.
Your demo replays a labelled reading stand-in. Voices are Gemini TTS.
Members check their own pay; the buyer traces its premium.
Every peso, traced to the pencil mark.
